title: sse: fix partial-JSON delimiter insertion and token/event ordering for streaming compatibility
author: Aisha Kapoor
release_notes: Fixes SSE streaming partial-JSON delimiter insertion and token/event ordering which could cause malformed JSON in some streaming clients. Improves OpenAI-compat layer ordering guarantees. Includes regression tests and fuzz harness updates.
body: Context: We observed intermittent client-reported errors (support INT-5643) where streaming responses using the SSE compatibility layer produced partial JSON fragments with misplaced delimiters and occasionally emitted token events out of sequence when using concurrent tokens+event multiplexing. This caused downstream parsers (OpenAI-compatible parsers and some browser clients) to see invalid JSON or attribute tokens to the wrong event. Motivation: ensure token/event ordering and delimiter insertion is deterministic and compatible with OpenAI SSE semantics; prevent regressions by adding tests and a fuzz harness.
commits: fix(sse): normalize delimiter insertion strategy and ensure chunk boundary safety
fix(sse/framing): guarantee start/end delimiter placement for partial-json streams
feat(tests): add sse partial-json fuzz tests and deterministic replay harness
chore(openai-compat): add explicit token-event ordering contract and doc comments
docs: update streaming.md with compatibility notes and migration steps
changed_files: src/sse/framing.rs: adjust delimiter state machine and add thorough comments
src/sse/streamer.rs: centralize flush semantics to preserve token ordering across backpressure
src/api/openai_compat.rs: explicit ordering guarantees and small adapter fixes
tests/sse_partial_json.rs: deterministic unit tests for delimiter sequences
tests/sse_fuzz.rs: fuzz harness and corpus for previously failing cases
docs/api/streaming.md: compatibility notes and upgrade guidance
ci/pipeline.yml: add fuzz job and increase timeout for streaming integration tests
ci_summary: Initial CI failed the streaming-integration test (timing sensitive). Fixed by increasing deterministic flush timeout and adding a replay harness; reran CI and all checks passed (unit, integration, fuzz).
review_comments: Ethan Park: The delimiter state machine looked fragile under concurrent writes — suggested centralizing flush in streamer.rs to make ordering explicit.
Aisha Kapoor: Addressed by moving delimiter emission into Streamer::flush_boundary and adding comments and tests that assert ordering under interleaved token/event writes.
Marisol Ortega: Added a fuzz harness but worried about nondeterminism in CI — suggested deterministic seed and replay corpus.
Aisha Kapoor: Added deterministic seeds generated from reported incidents and included a small corpus. CI runs the fuzz job in short mode and we run full corpus in nightly.
Liam Chen: Verified OpenAI-compat adapter now emits events in the expected sequence; approved after minor nits on doc wording.
Marisol Ortega: Approved — tests are robust and cover the regression from INT-5643.
discussion_notes: This PR fixes a long-standing edge case where partial JSON streaming plus our token-event multiplexing could result in a closing delimiter emitted before the final token boundary was flushed. Key change: make delimiter emission depend on the flushed token index rather than arrival order, and ensure flush is coordinated with backpressure signals. Also added explicit commentary in the openai_compat adapter about expected ordering so downstream SDKs can rely on the contract.
migration_steps: None required for most users. For self-hosted/private deployments: safe to apply; recommend bumping agent SDKs if they relied on previous non-deterministic behavior. Documented in streaming.md.
notes_for_release: Backported to release/2026-02 for hotfix consumers. Included in main release with targeted release notes about streaming stability and OpenAI compatibility.
user_impact: Fix reduces malformed JSON errors for clients consuming SSE streams and improves reliability for real-time SDKs using token-level events. No API contract change — behavior is more deterministic.
qa_approach: Added deterministic unit tests that replay previously failing token/delimiter sequences. Added fuzz corpus derived from incident traces and CI coverage for short mode. Nightly runs exercise the full corpus.
follow_up_items: ENG-2079: Add telemetry for delimiter-emit counts to detect regressions
ENG-2090: SDKs to add example parsers that rely on ordering contract
